title: shift rejects count 64 for int
purpose: The operation must fail instead of producing a value.

failure.justification: The contract makes the operation an error but leaves the detection stage open: a static pass may reject it when operand categories are known, otherwise it fails at runtime. It must never yield a value.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: bitwise guide: shift counts must be int in 0..W-1 (count 64 for int fails).
